breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'neglecting atmospheric pressure' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g), which directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires including atmospheric pressure: NPSHa = (p_atm/(rho g)) - hs - hL - (Pv/(rho g)) with p_atm = 101.3 kPa.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: By omitting atmospheric pressure, the generated specification treats the reservoir surface as having 0 pressure head (gauge) while subtracting vapor pressure Pv = 3.2 kPa (an absolute pressure). This mixing of gauge and absolute pressures is exactly the inconsistency that needed to be fixed. The ground truth resolves this by using absolute pressures throughout, including p_atm = 101.3 kPa.
